method: Official heritage descriptions, attributed OSM map data and browser-inspected linked plan and exterior photographs. No reference pixels distributed.

observations.observation: Copper-sheet and gilded dome described as over 50 m. Current wing completed 1889–1893.
Octagonal clock tower, moon clock and later sundial.
Distinct Michaeler, Amalien, Leopold, Chancellery, Swiss, riding, library, Neue Burg and other wings; open courts.
Concave white facade, arched central entrance, giant columns and three green ribbed copper domes with gold details.
Curved rusticated lower arcade, upper giant order and balustrade; taller central pavilion and balcony. Equestrian monument is separate.
Cream plaster, pale pilasters, rectangular windows, steep brown roofs, square chimneys and small dormers.
Clock pediment and sundial below octagonal copper turret and two onion roofs; brown tile roof and cream rusticated facade.
Open central arch, paired sculptural groups, upper balcony and giant pilasters. Main Michaeler dome rises behind.
